format.name: TENSOR_SHARDED
format.logical_identity: H(weft/tensor/logical/v1, WCB({schema:weft.tensor.logical.v1,dtype,shape,element_count,values_hash})) over sign-extended quantized words W and global block records B = per block u32le(f32 scale bits) || i64le(zero point)
format.shard_order: shard_index is authoritative; duplicate, missing, and out-of-range indices fail closed

commands.command: cargo build --release; hack/cross.sh rust-gen | go-build | go-gen | go-decode | rust-decode | compare

design_notes: The scale plane and the descriptor scales array are global (one f32 per whole-tensor block), and every shard carries both. This makes the logical root independent of shard axis/count and keeps each shard self-describing. It duplicates 4 * block_count bytes per shard; a future version may introduce a shard-local block partition with a new schema.
The descriptor scale value is a u64 WCB value whose low 32 bits are the exact f32 bit pattern and whose high 32 bits must be zero, because WCB has no u32 tag.

block_count is bounded by max_structured_items (default 1,000,000) because scales and zero_points are descriptor arrays; this is stricter than max_tensor_elements for large tensors and is stated in the spec.
Dequantization is out of band and is not part of identity; zero points are carried exactly.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and local in-memory/court operations only; no compression or performance claim.
The scale plane is duplicated per shard in v1; no shard-local block partition is implemented.
